priorities.summary: A deserialization flaw in the Station Launcher App of Dassault Systèmes' 3DEXPERIENCE platform lets an unauthenticated attacker run code on the server remotely. Dassault has released fix packs for every affected release — upgrade to a fix pack newer than the last affected one.
priorities.plain: Dassault's 3DEXPERIENCE platform lets anyone on the network run code on the server without logging in; install the latest fix pack now.

priorities.summary: A flaw in how FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer handle specially crafted web requests lets an unauthenticated attacker run code or commands on the management appliance. Fortinet has released fixed versions — upgrade and restrict the management interface to trusted networks.
priorities.plain: Fortinet's FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer let anyone on the network run commands on the management server; upgrade and lock down access now.

priorities.summary: A path traversal flaw in FortiMail lets an unauthenticated attacker reach files outside the intended directory and run code on the mail gateway. Fortinet has released fixed versions for all affected branches — upgrade now.
priorities.plain: Fortinet's FortiMail mail gateway lets anyone on the network run code on the server; upgrade to a fixed version now.

model.name: Qwen4-Max
model.summary: Alibaba's first Qwen4 model, Qwen4-Max, went generally available on November 16 after a two-week preview, bringing multimodal text, image and video understanding with a 1M-token context to its cloud API and apps.
model.plain: Alibaba's new flagship AI for long documents, coding and agent work, now available to businesses through its cloud API.
